source_reading.scope: Repository context, interface requirements (§3.2), RDF publication (§4), complete faceted browsing comparison (§5) and conclusion (§7).

adjudication.basis: Although repository construction is central, the primary report implements and compares real RDF faceted browsing interfaces for scientific images and their metadata. Browsing requirements, functionality and performance are directly evaluated, supporting eligibility under an interactive linked-data scope.
